baseline_models.focus_anchor: The whole construction joins present negation, the event's وقوع, and كاذبة.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negation removes any bearer of falsity while وقوع presents a fall that fixes itself in place; the event's realization is therefore its own evidence.

activation_trace.role: Present-state negation excludes any instance in which falsity could hold.
Falling into place and becoming fixed makes occurrence realized rather than merely alleged.
Contrariety to truth names precisely what the construction excludes.

changed_reading.before: A future event is asserted against possible denial.
changed_reading.after: Once the event falls into place, its occurrence is self-attesting: no state of affairs can make it false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وقعتها is an awaited arrival, and كاذبة can image delay or motion that breaks off.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negation reaches beyond verbal falsehood to temporal failure: what is expected neither tarries nor starts and then stops.

activation_trace.role: Negation blocks the failure modes attached to the awaited occurrence.
Expectation supplies the temporal horizon from which arrival is watched.
Not lingering or delaying turns truthfulness into prompt execution.
A run that stops and looks back supplies the interrupted course that is negated.

changed_reading.before: The prediction will prove true eventually.
changed_reading.after: The awaited event neither tarries nor breaks stride once its course begins.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وقعة can be an audible impact or battle collision, while كذب can mark a charge that fails.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase denies a feint or spent blow: the event's impact fully carries through.

activation_trace.role: Negation removes failure from the event's impact.
The heard force of a blow gives وقوع a concrete impact profile.
A charge is true when it presses through and false when it falters.

changed_reading.before: No report about the event is false.
changed_reading.after: The event itself is no feint: its blow lands and its charge does not fail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وقعتها can leave a written impress, and كاذبة can be a decorated cloth that misrepresents its condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event is read as an authentic impress opposed to counterfeit display: its actual mark cannot be replaced by a surface that lies about what is beneath.

activation_trace.role: Negation disallows a counterfeit representative of the event.
A signature or written trace supplies the event's durable, inspectable impress.
A cloth that lies by its appearance supplies the counterfeit surface being excluded.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: The verse rejects a false surface: the event leaves an impress that no decorative appearance can counterfeit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding verb-noun repetition performs the passage from falling to the named Event; 56:2 then closes off falsification of that enacted occurrence.

activation_trace.role: The focus noun retains the image of a fall becoming fixed.
Falsity is excluded from the now-enacted occurrence.
The repeated verb and noun move from falling to a fixed event and thus dramatize actualization.
The named severe event identifies the fall as a decisive visitation rather than a generic happening.

structural_cues: 56:1 places a finite وقوع and a cognate event-noun immediately before the focus's وقعتها.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cognate repetition; I read its direction as enactment becoming self-evidence, though it could function only as emphatic naming.

changed_reading.before: The occurrence is said to be undeniable.
changed_reading.after: The text first makes the Event happen in language and then declares that enacted happening impossible to falsify.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event verifies itself by operating on relative position and rank: what was high is lowered and what was low is raised, so truth appears as visible redistribution.

activation_trace.role: A fall that settles supplies the event's realized operation.
The excluded untruth becomes a condition contradicted by observable reversal.
Lowering after height supplies the downward half of the event's verification.
Raising supplies the opposed upward operation.
Elevation of standing extends physical reversal into a reversal of rank.

structural_cues: 56:3 consists of two opposed active descriptions with no intervening explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired lowering and raising; I infer that their visible effects verify 56:2, while a live alternative treats them simply as two attributes of the Event.

changed_reading.before: No speaker can successfully deny the event.
changed_reading.after: The event makes denial untenable by visibly reversing position and rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ground and mountain cease to support their former appearance: agitation, crushing and dispersal expose apparent solidity as contingent. The event's 'no lie' becomes a material truth-test.

activation_trace.role: Settling and fixation provide the physical register that the context overturns.
A surface that misstates its condition frames stable appearance as potentially deceptive.
Violent agitation removes the ground's apparent rest.
The lower surface opposite heaven supplies the supposedly stable base under test.
Breaking, wetting and mixing turn coherent mass into worked material.
Elevated solid gathering supplies the strongest emblem of durable form.
Fine scattered dust is the disclosed condition of the former mass.
Dispersal completes the loss of a surface able to maintain the old appearance.

structural_cues: 56:4-6 moves in sequence from shaking a base, through pulverizing elevated solids, to airborne dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material sequence; I infer that disintegration exposes prior solidity as a misleading surface, while the live alternative is destruction without an epistemic claim.

changed_reading.before: كاذبة concerns false speech about an event.
changed_reading.after: كاذبة also concerns false material appearance: the event tests forms until what looked immovable can no longer misstate its condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event converts an undifferentiated 'you' into disclosed cohorts, directions, precedence and nearness; no inherited or asserted status can falsify the resulting placement.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsity supplies the problem of a false label or status.
Peers gathered by shared form or work supply classification by actual affinity.
The explicit number fixes the disclosed social partition.
Right-side force and right supply one pole of assigned standing.
The left side supplies the opposed positional pole.
Repeated precedence identifies a cohort through enacted advance.
The privileged nearness of intimates converts precedence into relational standing.

structural_cues: 56:7 addresses the audience collectively, then 56:8-11 names distinct groups through repeated relational labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies partition, side, precedence and nearness; I infer that the Event reveals rather than invents their fitting relations, while an alternative reads the sequence as assignment without prior hidden identity.

changed_reading.before: The event cannot be falsely denied.
changed_reading.after: The event cannot be falsified by social self-description: it discloses each affiliation and standing through placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The settled result is tightly constituted, persistent, sourced and unfractured. كاذبة therefore also excludes an outcome that promises continuance but decays, stops or runs dry.

activation_trace.role: Milk expected to continue but failing supplies the image of a provision that breaks its promise.
Motion that runs and then stops supplies interrupted duration.
Tight interweaving supplies a result whose parts hold together.
Persistence not quickly reached by decay directly counters temporal failure.
A flowing source gives provision a continuing origin rather than a finite stock.
The ayah's negation of splitting removes fracture from the enjoyed result.

structural_cues: 56:15-19 accumulates support, circulation and continuity, then explicitly negates splitting and depletion.
The branchless root ن ز ف at 56:19 word 5 structurally marks the negated exhaustion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable construction, persistence, a source, and negated fracture/depletion; I infer these describe the Event's nonfailing settlement, while they may more narrowly describe only the drink and its setting.

changed_reading.before: The event will not fail to arrive.
changed_reading.after: What the event settles will not belie itself afterward by fraying, stopping or being exhausted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Choice and desire establish inward orientation; recompense then answers intentional work. Truth becomes exact correspondence between agency and settled outcome, not only correctness of prediction.

activation_trace.role: Fixing in place supplies the final settlement whose fit is at issue.
Opposition to truth becomes mismatch between action and result.
Choosing by seeking the good supplies deliberate preference.
The soul's movement toward what it wants supplies inward desire.
Answering an act with its recompense provides the correspondence arrow.
Intentional action supplies what the recompense answers.

structural_cues: 56:20-21 repeats 'from what they choose/desire,' and 56:24 closes the sequence with recompense for what they did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, desire, action and recompense; I infer an exact-fit relation that interprets falsity as mismatch, while an alternative keeps provision and recompense as separate relations.

changed_reading.before: The event is true because it occurs.
changed_reading.after: The event is true in correspondence: its settlement answers inward orientation and intentional action without mismatch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing soundscape removes discarded or harmful utterance and leaves repeated peace. The focus's excluded lie expands into a regime where speech is neither null noise nor injury but an effective declaration of wholeness.

activation_trace.role: False speech supplies the focus anchor for the later purification of what is heard.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes the soundscape consequential rather than merely acoustic.
The ayah negates speech discarded as weightless residue.
A thing's saying as its indication lets the remaining utterance manifest the state it names.
Repeated freedom from harm supplies the content and achieved condition of the utterance.

structural_cues: 56:25 negates two classes of utterance; 56:26 answers with an exception and doubles a single word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusion followed by repeated peace; I read the repetition performatively as speech matching state, while it may instead be only the content of a greeting.

changed_reading.before: No false assertion can attach to the event.
changed_reading.after: The event culminates in speech that no longer misfires: null and injurious utterance falls away, and the remaining word manifests wholeness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ع mapping for focus و ق ع, so it is form-distant and should be rendered as a spatial activation, not a lexical gloss. It remains anchored by the supplied split-root branch and by the context's conversion of elevated solidity into dispersed dust.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of وقعتها supplies a level expanse, while كاذبة supplies appearance that misstates condition.

activation_trace.role: A flat open expanse activates leveling inside the focus root's supplied split mapping.
A lying surface turns topography into a possible misleading display.
Raised solid mass supplies the topography to be undone.
Fine dispersed dust supplies the loss of raised form.

changed_reading.after: Its falling admits no lying topography: raised solidity is opened into an exposed, level field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-activates derived-person and battle branches rather than the ordinary syntax of ليس and كاذبة. It remains anchored in all three focus roots and gains contextual traction from repeated precedence; downstream prose should mark it as a martial image of inevitability, not a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ليس supplies the fighter who does not flinch, وقعة the battle collision, and كاذبة the charge that fails or holds true.

activation_trace.role: The fearless fighter who does not leave his opponent personifies unflinching advance.
Battle collision gives the event the form of an assault.
A true charge presses through, whereas a false one falters.
Repeated forward precedence provides the contextual image of those who fully advance.

changed_reading.after: The event advances like an assault with no flinching or false charge, and its full advance discloses the truly foremost.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain textile and enclosure reading. It is surprising because cover usually suggests concealment, yet it remains anchored in كاذبة's lying cloth and is sharpened by later branches for tight weaving and protective covering; render it as a contrast between counterfeit display and faithful preservation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كاذبة can image a cloth that lies by appearance, making the truth-value of covering itself an anchor.

activation_trace.role: The decorated cloth that misstates its condition supplies deceptive covering.
Tight interwoven construction supplies a covering whose integrity is real.
Protective concealment supplies a cover that preserves rather than counterfeits what it contains.
The pearl supplies the real value protected beneath the cover.

changed_reading.before: Every covering is suspect as concealment.
changed_reading.after: The event abolishes covering that lies while preserving covering that faithfully guards real value.

strongest_changes: The repeated وقوع of 56:1 turns certainty into enacted, self-attesting occurrence.
Lowering and raising make the event verifiable as reversal of position and rank.
The shaking-to-dust sequence turns كاذبة from false speech into material appearance exposed under stress.
Choice, desire, work and recompense recast truth as exact correspondence between agency and outcome.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact negation supported several mechanisms at once: self-evidence, uninterrupted execution, nonfailing impact, exposure of counterfeit form, truthful social placement, durable settlement and effective speech. The split ق و ع inventory also produced a contained leveling activation.
remaining_uncertainties: كاذبة may function as falsity, denial, a falsifying agent or a failed action; the focus alone does not force one of these.
The temporal, martial, textile and split-root readings are branch-supported but remain more form-distant than the self-attesting model.
The later durable and peaceful states may reveal properties of the Event's settlement, or may only describe one resulting cohort.
